    From github: https://github.com/mozilla-mobile/fenix/issues/15092.
    

    

    Steps to reproduce
    

    Go to settings delete browsing data and delete current tabs by selecting only the open tabs option
    

    Expected behavior
    

    The tabs do not appear in recently closed. Otherwise there would be no point to having that option.
    

    Actual behavior
    

    They do appear in recently closed. Feels like a privacy violation
    

    Device information
    

      

    • Android device: Asus Zenfone
      • 

    • Fenix version: Nightly
